test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following committees was formed to estimate poverty in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Tendulkar Committee**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tendulkar **committee led a group named after him, the** Suresh Tendulkar Committee**, which was in charge of researching the percentage of the population living **below the poverty line (BPL).**
 
• In 2011-12, the Tendulkar Committee determined poverty lines and poverty ratios based on** monthly per capita consumer expenditure.**
 
• As a result, the poverty line at the national level was projected to be **Rs 816 per capita in rural regions and Rs 1000 in urban areas.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** P.K Mohanty Group, **a committee formed by the RBI to assess the **medium-term route of financial inclusio**n, advised that a system of professional credit intermediates/advisers for MSME be explored.
 
• **Y.V. Reddy,** who was appointed to investigate the** analytical components of the monetary survey**, suggested the compilation of thorough analytical surveys.
